lines.text: Chat... we're whispering now. Hammer's off. Tonight, the fence works alone.
Awake! Totally awake. Eyes like an eagle.
Chat, I'm not scared. I'm... medium-key nervous.
He's not even looking at the seedlings...
He doesn't want the garden. He wants grubs.
Chat... I think we just met our neighbour.

msgs.text: wear a hat dear, its cold
u should give him his own spot

cards.meaning: watching quietly, waiting for something to happen
